title: Effect of Preoperative Intraocular Pressure in Patients with and without Intolerance to Their IOP-Lowering Medication on the Outcome of Trabectome Surgery

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 unported, incorporated in Dove Medical Press terms (article <license>); non-commercial, therefore private

indication: mild to moderate open-angle glaucoma (POAG 94, pseudoexfoliation 49, other OAG 12 eyes) under preoperative anti-glaucoma therapy, with or without intolerance to topical medication, 50 eyes with prior SLT; Trabectome ab interno trabeculectomy alone (79 eyes) or combined with phacoemulsification (76 eyes); groups by preoperative IOP control under treatment: <= 18 mmHg (group 1), 19-26 mmHg (group 2), > 26 mmHg (group 3); retrospective single-surgeon consecutive series (Bern, Switzerland)

groups.description: group 1: sufficiently controlled preoperative IOP (<= 18 mmHg under treatment, with glaucoma progression or intolerance); 69 eyes of 58 patients, 30 AIT alone and 39 phaco-AIT (t0001!R2C3, R8C3, R9C3)
group 2: insufficiently controlled preoperative IOP (19-26 mmHg under treatment); 63 eyes of 53 patients, 32 AIT alone and 31 phaco-AIT (t0001!R2C4, R8C4, R9C4)
group 3: uncontrolled preoperative IOP (> 26 mmHg under treatment); 23 eyes of 22 patients, 17 AIT alone and 6 phaco-AIT (t0001!R2C5, R8C5, R9C5)

series.notes: Group 1 'Mean ± SD' cells; rows Baseline, 1 day, 1 week, 1 months, 3 months, 6 months, 1 year; eyes per row in C4: 69, 65, 60, 64, 60, 63, 55 (ordinary attrition; 5 eyes of this group needed revision surgery within 12 months and the article does not state whether their later IOP was censored)

Group 2 'Mean ± SD' cells; rows Baseline, 1 day, 1 week, 1 months, 3 months, 6 months, 1 year; eyes per row in C6: 63, 62, 53, 57, 48, 52, 53 (ordinary attrition; 7 eyes needed revision surgery within 12 months, censoring not stated)

Group 3 'Mean ± SD' cells; rows Baseline, 1 day, 1 week, 1 months, 3 months, 6 months, 1 year; eyes per row in C8: 23, 21, 23, 22, 16, 17, 17 (ordinary attrition; 7 eyes needed revision surgery within 12 months, censoring not stated)

exclusions.reason: whole cohort duplicates the preoperative-condition subgroups of the same table (brief rule)

an alternative partition of the same 155 eyes; extracting it together with the Table 2 groups would duplicate eyes, so only the study's primary grouping (preoperative IOP control, Table 2) is extracted

exclusions.what: Table 4 subgroups by intolerance within groups 1-3 (baseline, 6 months, 1 year)
exclusions.reason: further partition of the same eyes as Table 2 (would duplicate eyes) and covers fewer time points
medians and IQRs are not admissible
the same table gives absolute IOP; absolute series used

exclusions.what: Table 5 numbers of topical glaucoma medications
exclusions.reason: medication numbers are not IOP series in schema 1.0.0; noted only

exclusions.what: surgical success percentages and revision counts (text)
exclusions.reason: success proportions and counts are not admissible

notes: Reference kind 'preoperative_medicated': all eyes were under preoperative anti-glaucoma therapy and the groups are defined by the IOP under treatment (Methods; Table 1 footnote); no washout described.
Tonometer not stated in the article, so method 'unstated'.
Groups are defined by the preoperative (reference) IOP category itself; each group mixes Trabectome alone and phaco-Trabectome eyes (counts in the group descriptions).
Both eyes of 22 patients are included (155 eyes of 133 patients); the authors report a negligible intraclass correlation.
Day 1 and Week 1 converted as 1/30.4375 and 7/30.4375 months (rounded to 4 decimals); '1 year' = 12 months.
Data are reported as mean ± SD and as median (IQR); only the mean cells are cited.
